mapper.update: UPDATE creator_profile SET slug = #{profile.slug}, display_name = #{profile.displayName}, headline = #{profile.headline}, bio = #{profile.bio}, avatar_url = #{profile.avatarUrl}, avatar_asset_id = #{profile.avatarAssetId}, banner_url = #{profile.bannerUrl}, banner_asset_id = #{profile.bannerAssetId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{profile.userId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, slug, display_name, headline, bio, avatar_url, avatar_asset_id, banner_url, banner_asset_id, status, version, follower_count, created_at, updated_at FROM creator_profile WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT user_id, slug, display_name, headline, bio, avatar_url, avatar_asset_id, banner_url, banner_asset_id, status, version, follower_count, created_at, updated_at FROM creator_profile WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id, slug, display_name, headline, bio, avatar_url, avatar_asset_id, banner_url, banner_asset_id, status, version, follower_count, created_at, updated_at FROM creator_profile WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_profile WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM creator_profile WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (avatar_asset_id = #{assetId} OR banner_asset_id = #{assetId}) LIMIT 1 )
